display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section headings. text-balance. One italic emphasis word in teal or mint.

title.purpose: Component-level headings: service names, pillar titles, doctor credentials.

body.purpose: All paragraph copy. Light weight. 65-72ch max line length. text-pretty.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows. Uppercase. Hairline prefix. Harbour Teal at 80%.

shadows.name: soft-ambient
shadows.purpose: Floating elements (modals, popovers). Flat at rest; shadow on lift only.

shadows.name: teal-glow
shadows.purpose: Harbour Teal element hover emphasis. Used on CTA buttons and focused teal components.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All entrance and state-transition animations. The system's only easing.

motion.name: entrance-word
motion.value: duration: 1s, delay staggered 0.09s per word, y: 110% → 0

motion.name: entrance-fade
motion.purpose: Subtitle, CTA, and section content fade-in on viewport enter.

components.name: Primary Button (Hero CTA)
components.description: White pill with plum text. Appears on dark hero backgrounds. Hover: mint fill.
components.html: Book an Appointment
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F0EEEB; color: #2A1520; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5EBF8A; color: #FAF9F7; } .ds-btn-icon { transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-icon { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A6E7E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav CTA Button
components.description: Plum pill with cream text. Fixed navbar booking action. Hover: teal fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #2A1520; color: #FAF9F7; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #1A6E7E; } .ds-btn-dot { display: inline-block; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #5EBF8A; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5EBF8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Text Link
components.description: Underlined text link for secondary CTAs on dark backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transition: color 200ms, text-decoration-color 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #FAF9F7; text-decoration-color: rgba(255,255,255,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5EBF8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Content tile in the services grid. Icon circle, heading, blurb. Hover: cloud cream bg, teal icon, bottom-line reveal.
components.html:
Dental Implants

Single tooth to full-arch — surgically guided implants placed for a lifetime of comfortable function.
components.css: .ds-service-card { position: relative; background: #F0EEEB; padding: 36px 40px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 500ms; overflow: hidden; } .ds-service-card:hover { background: #FAF9F7; } .ds-service-card__top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 32px; } .ds-service-card__icon { display: inline-flex; width: 48px; height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(26,110,126,0.08); color: #1A6E7E; transition: background 500ms, color 500ms; } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-card__icon { background: #1A6E7E; color: #FAF9F7; } .ds-service-card__arrow { color: rgba(42,21,32,0.3); transition: color 500ms, transform 500ms; } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-card__arrow { color: #1A6E7E; transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-service-card__name { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; color: #2A1520; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-service-card__blurb { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(42,21,32,0.65); } .ds-service-card__line { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 40px; right: 40px; height: 1px; background: #1A6E7E; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-card__line { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-service-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A6E7E; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow Label
components.description: Uppercase label that opens every section. Hairline prefix + teal text. Appears above every headline.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(26,110,126,0.8); } .ds-eyebrow__line { display: inline-block; height: 1px; width: 32px; background: rgba(26,110,126,0.4); margin-right: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Navbar (Scrolled State)

components.html:

components.css: .ds-navbar { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 40; transition: background 500ms, border-color 500ms; } .ds-navbar--scrolled { background: rgba(240,238,235,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,21,32,0.05); } .ds-navbar__inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 64px; height: 80px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-navbar__logo { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-navbar__logo-bio { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #2A1520; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-navbar__logo-lume { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-style: italic; color: #1A6E7E; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-navbar__logo-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #5EBF8A; margin-left: 4px; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-navbar__nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 36px; } .ds-navbar__link { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(42,21,32,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-navbar__link:hover { color: #1A6E7E; } .ds-navbar__cta { margin-left: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
Bio Lume's design system is built on a single conviction: that expertise speaks through what is removed, not what is added. Every token, spacing decision, and component choice exists because it earns its place — like an instrument tray where each tool has a precise reason for being there and nothing else. The system projects quiet authority: the kind of confidence that doesn't need to announce itself.

The palette carries warmth without softness, precision without coldness. Harbour Teal and Still Plum pair as complements that hold the site's emotional range, anchored by Warm Linen surfaces that read like good paper stock rather than clinical white. Misted Mint appears sparingly — the one voice that signals delight without performing it.

Motion is purposeful and rare. Entrances earn attention. Transitions confirm state. Nothing moves to decorate. Typography does the heavy lifting: the serif display face carries authority and unhurried confidence, while the light-weight sans body text signals clarity over effort.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: teal accent on ≤10% of surface; plum and linen carry the load
Serif display font at tight negative tracking (-0.04em) for editorial authority
Generous vertical rhythm (1.8 line-height in body) that slows the read down
Flat surfaces with rare tonal hover transitions; no decorative shadows
Motion: entrances only, expo ease-out, reduced-motion respected throughout

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Harbour Teal appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its scarcity makes it meaningful. If a new element reaches for teal because it 'feels premium', reconsider.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: #fff is prohibited. Every surface uses Warm Linen (#F0EEEB) or Cloud Cream (#FAF9F7). The warmth is intentional; clinical white belongs to the anti-reference, not the product.

rules.name: The Tracking Contract
rules.body: Display type is tight (-0.04em); label type is wide (+0.22em). Nothing in between uses arbitrary tracking. This range is the system's typographic signature.

rules.name: The Italic Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Italic is reserved for a single emphasis word per section heading. It appears in Harbour Teal or Misted Mint, never in Still Plum.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Components are flat at rest. A shadow appears only in response to state (hover elevation, modal layer, focused CTA). Reach for a background tint before a shadow.

dos: Do use text-pretty and text-balance on all heading and paragraph copy.
Do use serif italics for a single emphasis word per section heading — in Harbour Teal or Misted Mint.
Do use the label eyebrow pattern (hairline + uppercase label) to open every section.
Do keep spacing varied for rhythm: section verticals at py-28/py-36, internal gaps non-uniform.
Do keep Harbour Teal on ≤10% of any surface.
Do use Warm Linen as the universal canvas. Cloud Cream only for elevated or hovered surfaces.
Do use the bottom-line reveal (scaleX 0→1, origin-left) as the hover accent for service-style cards.
Do write copy that earns its specificity: 'Class-B autoclaved instruments, sealed packaging' beats 'highest hygiene standards'.
donts: Don't use #fff or #000. Both are banned.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe. Rewrite with background tints or the bottom-line reveal.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. Gradient text is prohibited.
Don't apply glassmorphism decoratively. Backdrop blur appears only on the navbar scroll state and mobile overlay.
Don't make the site look like a dental clinic: no blue crosses, no stock photo smiles, no clinical white.
Don't import luxury spa aesthetics: no marble textures, no gold foil, no 'wellness journey' framing.
Don't use SaaS metric templates: no hero numbers, no icon-grid feature lists, no gradient stat cards.
Don't animate layout properties. Transitions use opacity and y/x transforms only.
Don't open a modal when inline or progressive disclosure would work.
